_comment: Binds scenario -> diagram -> env -> thresholds so an acquisition scenario
cannot be run against a *-sim-* build by accident. Previously this pairing
lived only in a comment inside each .scenario.yaml ('Pair with a diagram
that sets hx711 missedReadyEvery > 0'), which meant a green result could
be produced from a build that never reads DT/SCK.
NOTE on rates: diagram attr 'actualSps' (94.22) drives cadence ONLY in the
real-HX711 harness envs. The *-sim-* envs ignore it entirely and use the
build flag WMBP_SIM_HX711_HZ instead. Two rate knobs exist; each env reads

A row with lintOnly:true is built and its diagram linted, but the simulator is not run. Use it for model-fidelity targets that cannot produce serial - it keeps compile coverage without a bogus runtime FAIL.

runs.name: clean-94hz
runs.why: Baseline cadence against a clean 94.22 SPS source.

runs.name: dout-missed-ready
runs.why: missedReadyEvery=97 (~1 dropped edge/sec at 94 Hz). Proves the timeout+level-poll recovery path: an edge-only design would stall permanently here.

runs.name: midstream-tare-loaded
runs.why: 27.5 g applied at 5s, then a serial tare. Exercises the owner-queued tare path under load.

runs.name: late-usb-enable
runs.why: USB stream enabled mid-run; acquisition must already be steady.

runs.name: tinys3d-feature-proxy
runs.why: TinyS3[D] firmware-feature proxy running on Wokwi's XIAO ESP32-S3 board. Exercises HX711 acquisition plus MAX17048 and LIS2DW12 I2C model wiring; it is not a TinyS3[D] hardware model, and TinyS3-only RGB, USB-sense pin fidelity, RF antenna switching, and board-variant behavior are outside this runtime row.

runs.name: hx711-pulse-trace
runs.why: Captures DT/SCK to VCD via wokwi-logic-analyzer, then asserts 25 clocks per conversion and no spurious DOUT-edge servicing. Replaces the 'optional logic-analyzer gate' with an automated one - note it proves pulse COUNT/ORDER, not real T3 width (WMBP_HX711_PULSE_SETTLE_US=3 widens pulses in the harness).

runs.name: float32-flow-ramp
runs.why: set-control sweeps applied weight at 2/4/8/14 g/s. Exercises the Float32 coherence gates on-device without a real pour.

runs.name: tinys3d-devkitc-feature-proxy
runs.why: TinyS3[D] firmware-feature proxy matched to Wokwi's DevKitC Arduino variant. Runs HX711 acquisition, MAX17048, Float32, GPIO17/18 wiring, and the GPIO35 USB-sense substitute. It is not a TinyS3[D] hardware model: GPIO35 cannot validate physical GPIO33, GPIO38 remains unconnected, and the real TinyS3 Arduino variant is covered only by separate builds/hardware.
